title: The Story of O
author: Pauline Réage
current_text: In New Zealand, the Indecent Publications Tribunal restricted The Story of O to professional psychiatrists in 1967; its permitted circulation expanded to include clinical psychologists in 1976, and the OFLC gave it an R16 classification in 2014.
